answer: Every identity must hold sybil-liability insurance from an independent underwriter with capital at stake. If the identity is proven farm-operated, the underwriter pays — so it performs due diligence and prices correlated risk: N heads sharing one hidden operator are one failure mode, an atlas of linked liabilities insurers won't cover cheaply. The farm stands on a ledge: hide the linkage and one exposure detonates the book; declare it and each head needs its own review. The honest agent is an oasis — one check, one low premium — while the farm funds the protocol's detection budget.
